livecheck.description: Livecheck MCP: verify, check, confirm, watch (+ verify_listing compat; watch_get/events/stop/chain_topup). No wallet — unpaid calls return structured 402. MCP does not settle payment. Default LIVECHECK_URL is production Verify. Override to http://127.0.0.1:43127/v1/verify only when running local npm start. Entry: src/mcp.ts → src/mcp-server.ts.
